command:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=''
for d in /home/ai-core-node/clay-global-research-entity /home/ai-core-node/*/clay-global-research-entity /home/ai-core-node/.claude/*/clay-global-research-entity; do [ -d "$d/.git" ] && { REPO="$d"; break; }; done
if [ -z "$REPO" ]; then REPO=$(find /home/ai-core-node -maxdepth 4 -type d -name clay-global-research-entity -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true); fi
[ -n "$REPO" ] && [ -d "$REPO/.git" ] || { echo REPO_NOT_FOUND; exit 31; }
echo REPO=$REPO
echo BEFORE_HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q origin chatgpt-work/avatar-idle-expression-falsifier-gpt56sol-20260912
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/avatar-idleexpr-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git -C "$REPO" archive origin/chatgpt-work/avatar-idle-expression-falsifier-gpt56sol-20260912 research_entity/avatar | tar -x -C "$TMP"
cd "$TMP/research_entity/avatar"
node test_idle_expression_engine.js
node test_idle_expression_state.js
node test_idle_expression_falsifiers.js
echo AFTER_HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')
echo FALSIFIER_RUN=PASS
